purpose: Fingerprint validity, configured asset references, and rewritten CSS dependencies are checked with cache_safe minification.
known_gap: With cache_safe enabled, a cached stylesheet is emitted upstream before privacy rewrites are applied. Dependencies are rewritten before hashing and minification by native privacy.
